units.source_text: 雪，使我恢复了少年般的心情。

en.t: The snow restored in me a boyish feeling.

units.source_text: 何况即使过了年我也才18岁呢。

en.t: Besides, even after the New Year, I was still only eighteen.

units.source_text: 就算我感到体内充满了少年般的跃动，这也会成为虚伪的吗？

en.t: Even if I felt my body filled with a boyish vitality, would that too become false?
